allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Blind traveler Zatoichi is a master swordsman and a masseur with a fondness for gambling on dice games. When he arrives in a village torn apart by warring gangs, he sets out to protect the townspeople.

facts.overview: Blind traveler Zatoichi is a master swordsman and a masseur with a fondness for gambling on dice games. When he arrives in a village torn apart by warring gangs, he sets out to protect the townspeople.
facts.title: Zatoichi

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Behind the humble guise of a dice-rolling traveler lies lethal precision, but can one man quiet an entire town's crossfire?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Blind masseur and gambler Zatoichi wanders into a community terrorized by ruthless warring gangs. Armed with exceptional swordsmanship, he steps between the local townspeople and escalating violence.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful samurai action with moderate emotional weight and engaged drama, perfect alone or with friends.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Takeshi Kitano, this fast-moving samurai action-drama pairs suspenseful village warfare with kinetic, stylized swordplay and steady dramatic momentum.
